title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 14 in F-sharp minor

character.text: Stile antico and ricercar-influenced (chromatic subject, 6/4), joined to the modern style

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 7–8), with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the bass, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a seventh every half bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 28–29).
sections.leads: Between two statements in F♯ minor; perfect cadence in C♯ minor at bar 20

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to C♯ minor

sections.label: Subject in C♯ minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 18–20), with the bass's line in the alto, a fifth higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From C♯ minor to F♯ minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in F♯ minor

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Returns in Episode 1 (bars 18–20).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (7 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
